name: Winter Lover
source:
A bored kumiho becomes obsessed with stealing the soul of a cheery university student but it grows into a larger issue when she finds herself fascinated with human culture and with the very human she wants to kill.

[From [url=https://smud.itch.io/winter-lover]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一只百无聊赖的九尾狐，一心想夺走一名开朗大学生的灵魂。然而，当她逐渐迷上人类文化，也被那个原本想杀死的人吸引时，事情变得复杂起来。

[摘自[url=https://smud.itch.io/winter-lover]itch.io[/url]]
